metadata.title: Cybersecurity Standards for Cloud Systems — High Impact, Cloud Service Customer

props.name: certification
props.value: Certified by a certify body on a 3-year cycle. This includes a full certification in the 1st year and a surveillance audit in the 2nd and 3rd years

metadata.remarks:
High Impact baseline for a Cloud Service Customer (CSC), from the minimum-requirements matrix in clause 4 of the annex.

Selects 39 of the catalog's 39 cloud service customer controls, of which 11 are added at this level (5.2.5, 5.2.6) over the moderate-impact profile.

Minimum requirements as the matrix states them: Part One: - All Part Two: - All

Certification required of the cloud service customer at this level: Certified by a certify body on a 3-year cycle. This includes a full certification in the 1st year and a surveillance audit in the 2nd and 3rd years

This profile is a rendering of a published standard and carries no roles or parties: the National Cyber Security Committee issued the standard, not this file.
